## 💡 Project Ideas

> *Context: 2026 AI finance trends centre on agentic tools. Open-source ecosystem is strong: TradingAgents (80k+ stars), QuantStats, PyPortfolioOpt. Australian-specific data (RBA, ASX) is publicly accessible. Multi-agent fund simulations are a live category.*

---

### Project 1 — Macro Sentinel
**Difficulty:** EASY · 3–4 days to MVP

**One-line pitch:** AI agent reads RBA statements and FOMC minutes overnight, scores hawkish/dovish tone, and sends a structured FX risk briefing before markets open.

**Problem it solves:** FX desk morning prep takes 2+ hours of manual reading across central bank communications; this automates the scan, scores the tone, and delivers a structured briefing in minutes.

**Stack:** Python, Claude Haiku 5.5, FRED API (free), PyMuPDF, BeautifulSoup, yfinance, SMTP/Telegram, GitHub Actions scheduler

**Build time:** 3–4 days to working prototype; 1.5 days to polish

**Who cares:** Afterprime FX desk, trading ops managers, macro-focused portfolio managers

**LinkedIn angle:** "I cut 2 hours of Monday prep to 5 minutes with an AI agent that reads central bank PDFs and scores risk for AUD pairs."

---

### Project 2 — ASX Earnings Scout
**Difficulty:** MEDIUM · 7–10 days to MVP

**One-line pitch:** RAG-powered AI analyst that ingests ASX company announcements and answers analyst-style questions across all of them with citations.

**Problem it solves:** Equity research across dozens of ASX filings is manual and time-consuming; RAG + Claude enables natural language Q&A with traceable sources across the full document corpus.

**Stack:** Python, Claude Sonnet 4.6, LlamaIndex, ChromaDB, PyMuPDF, yfinance (.AX tickers), Streamlit, asx.com.au scraping (no paid API)

**Build time:** 7–10 days MVP; 3 days to portfolio-ready

**Who cares:** Investment management recruiters, equity research desks, buy-side analysts, VC firms

**LinkedIn angle:** "I asked an AI what Australian banks said about NIM in the last 6 months. It read 40+ ASX announcements and gave a synthesised answer with citations in 30 seconds."

---

### Project 3 — AlphaDesk
**Difficulty:** HARD · 10–14 days to MVP

**One-line pitch:** Simulated hedge fund with three Claude agents (Analyst, Risk Manager, PM) that generates investment decisions, enforces risk limits, and produces investor-letter PDFs.

**Problem it solves:** Demonstrating investment process, risk discipline, and systems thinking in a portfolio — the exact questions PM interviews ask — without needing to manage real capital.

**Stack:** Python, Anthropic SDK (multi-agent), Claude Sonnet 4.6, yfinance, QuantStats, PyPortfolioOpt, Streamlit, fpdf2, SQLite decision log

**Build time:** 10–14 days MVP; 3–4 days to portfolio-ready

**Who cares:** Fund management recruiters, VCs evaluating founder-operators, immigration assessors evaluating 186 PR claims

**LinkedIn angle:** "I can't manage a hedge fund yet. So I built one in code. Three AI agents, a systematic strategy, 18 months of backtested data. Here's what I learned."

**Recommended sequence:** Macro Sentinel this week (employer/visa value). ASX Earnings Scout during CAIA study (research reinforcement). AlphaDesk when anchoring a PM job application or fund pitch.
